focus.product: Pump, valve and wellhead parts (impellers, casings, shafts, bearing housings, valve bodies and trims, wellhead spools, forged flanges) for oil and gas, water and fire protection
focus.why: 22 TKDN-certified pump, valve, wellhead, flange, fitting and meter makers sit in Cimanggis/Limo (Depok) and Citeureup-Gunung Putri-Cileungsi-Klapanunggal-Gunung Sindur, plus Bukaka; Duraquipt already certifies pump parts at 96.8-99.8% local content; SKK Migas is pushing local pumps (2026); Indonesia imported US$300.0M of pump parts (40% from China) and US$185.7M of valve parts in 2025; the province's own spatial plan lists machinery and fabricated metal for WP Bodebekpunjur.

also.product: Cement-plant wear and spare parts (crusher hammers and liners, mill and kiln parts, gears, conveyor parts) for Indocement Citeureup and SBI Narogong
also.why: Two large cement plants are in the unit (TKDN addresses); SBI's website carries SIG (Semen Indonesia Group) branding, and SIG's SME spare-parts programme already replaced 10 imported part types; Indonesia imported US$288.1M of 847490 parts in 2025, 49% from China.

also.product: Medical-device and pharma-production parts: device components, orthoses, prostheses and dental models (3D-printed) and tablet-press tooling and change parts (CNC)
also.why: Depok's draft industry plan names medical, dental, orthopaedic and prosthetic devices (KBLI 32502) a leading product; Kab. Bogor's plan prioritises pharma and medical devices; TKDN shows 10+ device makers and 7+ pharma plants here; 9021 imports were US$71.9M in 2025.

focus.product: Agro-food processing machines and their machined wear parts (rollers, shafts, cutters, screens, gears) for tea, coffee, cocoa/cashew, soy/tofu, rice and feed
focus.why: Kemenperin counted 209 metal IKM in Kab. Sukabumi (2020), including farm machinery and appropriate-technology tools; TKDN shows Phonna Raya (66 KOHPAD machines, up to 78.8% local content), Karya Insan Gemilang (cocoa/cashew) and Azaki (tofu, LIK Cibatu); the units grow tea, coffee, rice and milk; these parts are imported mostly from China (843390: 88%).

also.product: Forged blades, agricultural hand tools and police/ceremonial hardware from the Cibatu (Cisaat) smithing centre, upgraded with laser blanking, CNC grinding and CNC-made forging dies
also.why: Cibatu is a long-standing metal-craft village with a small-industry estate (LIK); TKDN certifies Cibatu/Kebonpedes golok, knives, officer swords and handcuffs; Kemenperin counted forging/blacksmith IKM making farm and household tools (2020).

also.product: Spare and wear parts for cement, geothermal and coal-power plants (Semen Jawa, Salak geothermal, PLTU Palabuhanratu)
also.why: Named plants with recurring maintenance demand sit in the unit; 847490 imports were US$288.1M in 2025, 49% from China; no local machine shop serving them was verified, so this is a buyer-led opportunity.
